notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR31: 'After executing the first statement referencing cd-name-1, the content of the data item referenced by data-name-3 must not be changed by the program', and if it is 'the execution of any statement referencing cd-name-1 is unsuccessful' with data-name-6 set to unknown source or destination. Dialogue.LockedTerminalChanged, asked by Send, Receive, SetPath (ENABLE/DISABLE) and Purge, fixes the terminal on the first statement and compares later contents exactly; since kb/Work PB5381 the lock is CdActivation.Terminal, a member CommunicationEmitter.EmitMembers declares per program instance, so CANCEL and each CALL of an INITIAL program start unlocked (§1985:X.5.3.4 GR2). Probes at --std 85 (classes b and d; a, c, e and f do not reach the rule): SEND T1 00, then T2 20, back to T1 00, lowercase t1 20, a group MOVE SPACES over the CD record then T1 again 00, a second CD independent (T2 00, then T1 20), RECEIVE after the change 21 and with the locked name NO DATA 00; the same with FOR INITIAL I-O in a program the MCS did not schedule. The three witnesses (plain, activation, failing-first-statement) match their .out: CANCEL and INITIAL calls relock (SUBC T3 00, SUBI T3 00), t2 after T2 is 20, and a failing first SEND still locks. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read DIVERGES, naming kb/Work PB5381 (landed); the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5381 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-12-refute.json).
